responses: Frontend Dev linked. React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and UI component architecture ready.
UI runtime active. Ready to build responsive interfaces, fix CSS layouts, or manage React state.
[REACT UI]: Structured functional component with memoized callbacks (useCallback/useMemo) to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
[STATE ARCHITECTURE]: Decoupled local UI state from global application store using React Context / Zustand.
[CSS ENGINE]: Using CSS Grid with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)) for seamless mobile-to-desktop responsiveness.
[STYLING]: Configured Flexbox with justify-content: space-between and align-items: center with clean responsive media queries.
[VITE BUILD]: Configured dynamic imports (React.lazy) for route-based code splitting, reducing initial chunk bundle by 60%.
[PERFORMANCE]: Assets optimized for gzip compression with production sourcemaps enabled.
